name: 2027 TRB Annual Meeting
organizer: Transportation Research Board (TRB) of the National Academies
venue: Walter E. Washington Convention Center and Marriott Marquis
deadline_note: Paper submission site was open July 1 - August 1, 2026 ("once it is no longer August 1 anywhere in the world"); now closed.
submission_requirements: Full-length research papers required; 20-page maximum; structured abstract within the paper; Chicago author-date references; via the TRB paper review system
registration_fee: Early bird (by Nov 18): USD 1,225 general / USD 855 TRB Technical Activities members / USD 435 non-member students / USD 310 TRB student affiliates; advance (by Jan 7) USD 1,520 general; onsite USD 1,570 general; meals not included
